name: Vinati Organics
why: Record quarterly sales, annual sales, annual profit
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 119% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Margins shrinking (31% to 26%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 96 to 87, inventory days 66 to 99 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (COGS 91% to 96% of sales)

guidance: While demand softened from October 2025, impacting our ability to meet the full year target, we have witnessed a recovery and expect approximately 15% to 20% volume growth in FY 2027.
IB and HP -MTBE reported a stable performance during the year, and we expect both products to achieve double - digit growth in FY 2027.
capex: We expect this segment to maintain strong momentum in FY 2027, supported by market expansion and ongoing product development.
In FY 2026, we incurred approximately INR270 crores in capex, including investments in V OPL towards capacity expansion, new product development and operational scalability.
risks: Our antioxidants business delivered an impressive 15% revenue growth in FY 2026 , despite a challenging market environment.
